name: @12-apps/thermal-printing
description: Receipt printing for the two ways a thermal printer is attached, behind ONE fixed-width document. Isomorphic line model and wrapping (./), the ESC/POS encoder with its CP850 code page (./escpos), the same lines as a print-ready HTML document for a printer on a cable (./html), the raw :9100 socket transport for a printer with an address (./net), and per-destination routing with a default (./routing). Carries no product copy: failures are structured, so the host says them in the reader's language. Standardized adoption contract in ADOPTING.md.
